question: Which driver has the fastest lap time? Please give their forenames and surnames.
clarification: Ignore rows where fastestLapTime is missing.
gold: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.fastestLapTime FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.fastestLapTime FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1

b.request: Which driver has the single fastest (minimum) fastestLapTime in the results table, considering only rows where fastestLapTime is not null, and what are their forename and surname?
b.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1

c.request:
Which driver has the fastest lap time? Please give their forenames and surnames.
Ignore rows where fastestLapTime is missing.
c.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> '' ORDER BY (CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which driver has the fastest lap time, ignoring rows where fastestLapTime is missing? Please give their forenames and surnames.
